thread:
PagerDuty: [ALERT] PROBE_FAILURE us-central1 - 18 probes failing across 3 AZs. Triggered at 02:14 UTC. Severity: potential customer impact. https://pd.example/incidents/INC-4821
Tara K: seeing the PD alert, jumping in. any known maintenance?
Matt L: nothing on our side in us-central1. no infra changes in the last 2h.
Anika R: dashboards look weird — probe counts dropped to zero then spiked. some probe agents show "no telemetry".
Josh P: I can run quick network checks from a healthy host in us-west to targets.
Tara K: thanks. also can someone check Route53 health check state? might be a false-positive flip.
OpsBot: Incident INC-4821 created by PagerDuty. Priority set to P2 -> escalate to P1 if >5m customer errors.
Matt L: doing traceroute to probe endpoints (from us-west).
Matt L: ```
traceroute to probe-01.us-central1.redwood.net (10.32.5.11), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1  0.9 ms
 2  100.64.0.5  1.2 ms
 3  * * *
 4  35.182.14.12  28.4 ms
 5  35.182.14.12  28.4 ms
```
Anika R: dig on the Route53 check domain shows intermittent NXDOMAIN then normal. looks like a route flip?
Anika R: ```
;; QUESTION SECTION:
;probe-check.us-central1.redwood.net. IN A
;; -> SERVER: 10.0.0.2#53(10.0.0.2)
;; ANSWER: ;; got NXDOMAIN
```
Tara K: customer-facing: some requests to hosted API in us-central1 are returning 522/timeout and increased p95 latency ~3x for a subset of customers. Not widespread but multiple SE reports.
Josh P: I pulled the agent logs from the probe fleet; agents show "heartbeat suppressed: silence policy" starting 02:10 UTC, but the policy wasn't changed. Suspect monitoring proxy overloaded and auto-silenced probes.
SRE-NOC: flagged to cloud NOC - reaching out to provider to check network control-plane in us-central1.
Matt L: I can temporarily disable health check suppression for the region to get telemetry back. Will that spam pages?
Anika R: do it but filter to avoid cascading alerts. we need data to know if probes are actually failing or just silent.
Tara K: Matt, also add a short-lived override that keeps monitors from suppressing for 10m, we'll watch.
Matt L: override applied: monitoring.proxy.silence=false (10m).
OpsBot: monitor override applied by Matt L.
Matt L: telemetry coming back for ~40% of probes. still seeing ~12 agents with connection reset.
Josh P: digging into a sample agent log: "connect() to control-plane timed out, falling back to local DNS" then "route update: rejected".
Tara K: routing team — any recent ASN flaps or BGP changes in us-central1? @SRE-NOC
SRE-NOC: provider reports partial control-plane API latency spike 02:08-02:22 UTC, correlated with route controller restarts in the region. they're investigating.
Anika R: impact assessment so far: - Affected surface: API hosts in us-central1 behind elastic pool - Customer symptoms: intermittent 502/522 and slow streaming responses - Approx % of traffic impacted: 6-9% of us-central1 traffic during spike window
Tara K: mitigation plan: 1) keep override for 30m 2) route impacted traffic to us-west fallback for critical customers 3) open CS notice for customers with high error rates 4) continue provider escalation.
Josh P: I'll start a canary reroute for top 5 customers; will use traffic policy to shift to us-west with sticky sessions off.
Anika R: add a quick eval prompt set for Redwood Optimize to watch generation quality after reroute (latency/cost) — avoid silent regression.
Matt L: started reroute rule: traffic-route=us-west fallback for customer tags: enterprise-tier:true (rolling 2m).
Tara K: good. update PD: change severity to P1 because customers are affected and partial outage persists.
PagerDuty: INC-4821 severity escalated to P1 by Tara K. Notifying leadership.
SRE-NOC: provider now reports control-plane recovered at 02:28 UTC. they're rolling a fix for route controller race.
Matt L: probes show healthy now after override lifted and 15m warmup. I've removed the override, monitoring back to normal suppression rules.
Anika R: final impact note: estimated 0.5% increase in token cost due to reroutes and retries for the affected window. Customers directly impacted: txn-42, partner-acme, corp-beta (CS pinged).
Tara K: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @Matt L you have night oncall — take post-incident monitoring and follow up with Provider for RCA. please update INC ticket with timeline and customer list.
Matt L: taking handoff. will follow up and open a postmortem if provider RCA indicates control-plane regression.
Josh P: leaving a quick debugging snippet for postmortem: ```
# sample: check probe suppression count
curl -s https://monitoring-api.internal/regions/us-central1/probes | jq '.agents[] | select(.status=="silenced") | {id,agent_version,last_seen}'
```
OpsBot: INC-4821 annotated: "temporary reroute applied; provider control-plane spike; probes silenced by proxy auto-suppression; override used to restore telemetry."
Tara K: thanks everyone. closing channel for live mitigation. please add follow-up tasks to the INC ticket and assign owners. :thumbsup:
Matt L: will do. leaving final note: if any customers keep seeing errors after 03:00 UTC reopen and escalate.
Anika R: will add eval alerts and the prompt set to track quality regressions post-reroute.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-4821 resolved (monitoring) at 02:45 UTC — keep oncall assigned to Matt L for follow-ups.
